integrity: Uniform proofs use exact cubic restriction, rational parametrization of tangent exclusions and incidence double-counting; finite-field certificates independently check sample fields and do not constitute the infinite proof. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full rational two-dimensional torus on the specific cubic X1 X2 X3=X0^3 and ambient rational projective lines, not all lines geometrically contained in the cubic or arbitrary toric polygons. Closely related toric-code and generalized Hamming-weight literature has been examined, but undiscovered equivalent finite-geometric trisecant counts remain a priority risk. The first generalized Hamming weight is not determined.
title: Exact finite-field secant spectrum of the exceptional-triangle toric cubic
